plainName: Interest on deposits of a senior citizen
summary: If you are a senior citizen — resident in India and sixty or more at any time in the year — interest on any deposit with a bank, a co-operative bank or a post office, fixed deposits included, is deducted up to a limit. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: Deposit interest of a senior citizen
routes.description: The interest on any deposit, up to the higher limit.

disqualifiers.description: Deposit interest is not deducted in the default regime.
You are not resident in India, or not sixty at any time in the year.
Interest from anyone other than a bank, a co-operative bank or a post office — a company deposit or a loan — is not deducted.
Where an expense is entered against the deposit interest, the deduction is not computed.

enforcedBy.reason: whether the interest is taken before or after the expense is not settled
